about: 2026-11-01 evening (arenas-rev, 0.38.23): STARRCADE's own walls (no table: Revenge's square at 530), then RAW IS WAR's -- 2026-11-01, the user: RAW played after a WCW Revenge arena keeps that arena's smaller ringside. Two CPU matches in one game: STARRCADE, then RAW IS WAR. qa_walls: state.csv bs_tries = the -z barricade's least z as the match's collision walks it (u16: -690 0xFD4E the game's, -530 0xFDEE Revenge's) | the +x side's (id 14: -615 / -455) << 16; bs_grabs = the least z of the walk | records << 16; bs_step = arena_current | arena_ring's ring_k << 8 | rec_n << 16. A camera on the -z side (the table / barricade). RAW's must be the game's own walls.
